messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Rozwozi części samochodowe po Krośnie; zagląda do telefonu w przerwie obiadowej.
- zainteresowania: myjnie bezdotykowe, drożdżówki z kruszonką, stare radia
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: parking przy ulicy Kolejowej w Krośnie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Urządza schowek na narzędzia w wynajmowanym garażu.
- sposób pisania: zdania: medium; interpunkcja: przecinki stawia nieregularnie; wielkie litery: mostly standard, lowercase starts; literówki: rare; skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: no
- tik językowy: wtrąca „po drodze wyszło”

For each of the 12 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. sport - piłka z kumplami na orliku (afternoon, Thursday)
2. technologia i sprzęt - backup, utracone zdjęcia (afternoon, Thursday)
3. pogoda - wiatr, burza (morning commute, Saturday)
4. remont i dom - zmiana dostawcy internetu (late morning, Sunday)
5. pogoda - upał (morning commute, Wednesday)
6. pogoda - ładny wieczór, zachód słońca (morning commute, Tuesday)
7. pogoda - wiatr, burza (early morning, Thursday)
8. dzieci i rodzina - dziadkowie, telefon (late night, Thursday)
9. technologia i sprzęt - padła bateria / ładowarka (evening, Wednesday)
10. praca i grafik - nowy projekt / nowe zadanie (evening, Saturday)
11. praca i grafik - nowy projekt / nowe zadanie (late morning, Saturday)
12. pogoda - mgła rano (morning commute, Sunday)

Return a JSON array of 12 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
